# Determine if Lukáš Melich's highest finish was as a junior
# First, identify all competitions that are junior events
junior_keywords = ['junior', 'u23', 'universiade']
# Create a boolean mask for junior competitions
junior_mask = df['competition'].str.contains('|'.join(junior_keywords), case=False, na=False)

# Get the best (lowest numerical) position among all competitions
# Convert position column to numeric by extracting the numeric part and converting to integer
df['position_numeric'] = df['position'].str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(float)
best_position_overall = df['position_numeric'].min()

# Get the best position among junior competitions
best_junior_position = df.loc[junior_mask, 'position_numeric'].min()

# Check if the best overall position is equal to the best junior position
# and that the best overall position actually comes from a junior competition
# We need to verify that the row(s) with the best overall position are junior competitions
best_rows = df[df['position_numeric'] == best_position_overall]
best_rows_are_junior = junior_mask[best_rows.index].all()

answer = (best_position_overall == best_junior_position) and best_rows_are_junior
